content.title: Is 'Sinners' Star Michael B. Jordan In a Relationship?
content.text: Is Michael B. Jordan In a Relationship? Inside the ‘Sinners’ Star’s Dating History Julian Hamilton/Getty Images Michael B. Jordan has a lot to celebrate this awards season. The actor’s vampire horror movie, Sinners, has earned an abundance of nominations and wins. Just ahead of the 98th Academy Awards, the Ryan Coogler-directed film earned the Best Ensemble Cast trophy at the Actor Awards. The same night, Jordan himself was named Best Actor for his performance as twins Elijah “Smoke” Moore and Elias “Stack” Moore, giving him plenty of momentum for the Oscars. Since Jordan could win big at the March 15 ceremony, you may have found yourself wondering about his real-life relationship status. After all, romance is a key element of Sinners — Jordan has equally hot chemistry with both of his characters’ love interests, played by Wunmi Mosaku and Hailee Steinfeld. At the aforementioned Actor Awards, Jordan did bring a special someone, but does he have a date on his arm at the Oscars? Swooon has a deep dive into the actor’s romantic life below. Does Michael B. Jordan have a girlfriend? Jordan last gave an update on his love life in April 2025. While promoting Sinners, he clarified that he was focused on his career, but he’s been vocal about wanting a family in the future. He told GQ that he was going to “sacrifice all my 20s to my work” and settle down in his 30s. The actor is now 38 and acknowledges his timeline shift is due to wanting to build “something solid” with his career. “Just because I’m competitive, and I know I would want to be the best dad,” he said. “But right now, I’m trying to do my best at this part [of my life] as well.” He added, “I’m not tripping over it. I’m so work focused. I would want somebody to fit into the flow of my life, of where I am. And that’s timing, right? You can meet the right person, and be at the wrong time, and it just doesn’t work out. I think the person that’s going to be right for me lines up with the timing with who she is as a person, where I’m at in my life, how open I am to even…to that, you know?” It seems that his stance hasn’t changed in the past year. Jordan was joined by his mother, Donna, on the red carpet of the Actor Awards, which occurred on March 1. He hasn’t been linked to anyone romantically thus far in 2026, either. Who has Michael B. Jordan been in a relationship with? Jordan’s longest known relationship was with Lori Harvey, Steve Harvey‘s daughter. They started dating in November 2020. “I’m still private, and I want to protect that, but it just felt like it was a moment of just wanting to put it out there and move on,” he told People in 2021 about his relationship with Harvey. “I am extremely happy.” Frazer Harrison / Getty Images Just a few months after making their red carpet debut as a couple at the 2022 Vanity Fair Oscars after-party, Jordan and his then-girlfriend broke up. “Michael and Lori are both completely heartbroken,” a source told People. “They still love each other.” According to sources, Jordan was “ready to commit for the long term,” but Harvey “wasn’t ready to commit.” Jordan “let down his guard with her, opening up emotionally in a romantic relationship for the first time.” Did Michael B. Jordan date Nicki Minaj? No, Michael B. Jordan and Nicki Minaj were never in a relationship. Dating rumors swirled after Minaj gave the actor a flirty shoutout at the E! People’s Choice Awards in 2018. During her acceptance speech for Female Artist of 2018, the rapper said, “And shoutout to Michael B. Jordan cause he’s gonna be taking it off of me tonight.” When asked backstage about name-dropping Jordan, Minaj admitted that she had only met the actor once at the Met Gala. “I was watching Black Panther last night, so he was just…happened to be fresh in my mind,” she told E! News. Jordan’s performance as the villainous Killmonger in the Marvel movie was certainly memorable!
